title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth Proofs Of The 7 Attributes Especially Life

questions.question: How does the passage say the attribute of Speech makes Allah known?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: How does the attribute of Power make Allah known in a different way?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through His works and their effects in creation.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the effects of Power?
questions.answer: They are compared to meaningful expressions that take visible form.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the whole universe resemble when viewed through Power?
questions.answer: It resembles a living book spread across the cosmos that points to its Majestic Maker.

questions.question: Through what kinds of created things does the attribute of Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through created things that are wise, orderly, balanced, directed, decorated, and clearly distinguished.

questions.question: Why is the attribute of Life presented as especially strongly proven?
questions.answer: Because it is supported not only by its own signs but also by the proofs that point to the other attributes.

questions.question: Which beings are described as witnesses to the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Living creatures are its witnesses because they reflect many signs of Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage say Life does to the universe?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing and changing it so fresh displays and patterns keep appearing.

questions.question: What image is used to describe the universe after this renewal?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a great mirror made up of countless smaller mirrors.

questions.question: Which other attributes are said to reveal the Most Sacred Essence?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech also reveal Him.

questions.question: How does the passage connect attributes like Knowledge and Hearing to Life?
questions.answer: It says such qualities are signs that life is present, since they belong to a living being.

questions.question: What conclusion is drawn about the place of Life among the attributes?
questions.answer: Life is presented as a central foundation that supports the other attributes and has especially many proofs.

questions.question: What are the two main ways mentioned in the passage by which Allah is made known?
questions.answer: He is made known through revelation and inspiration on one side, and through creation and its signs on the other.

questions.question: What role does Power play in helping a person recognize Allah?
questions.answer: It shows His existence through skillful works that display strength, wisdom, and glory.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare the universe to a book?
questions.answer: Because creation is treated as full of meaning that points beyond itself to its Maker.

questions.question: What do individual created things show about the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Their order, balance, beauty, and careful management show that they come from perfect knowledge.

questions.question: Besides its own direct evidence, what other support does Life receive?
questions.answer: It is backed by the signs of Power, Knowledge, and the rest of the Divine attributes.

questions.question: Why are living beings important in the argument for Life?
questions.answer: They act like witnesses that display many signs of Allah’s living action and sustaining care.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the ongoing changes in the cosmos according to the passage?
questions.answer: They allow new manifestations and new designs to appear again and again.

questions.question: What does the mirror image suggest about the universe?
questions.answer: It suggests that countless things in creation reflect signs of Allah.

questions.question: What is the relationship between Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech and the Most Sacred Essence?
questions.answer: Each of these attributes reveals and makes the Essence known.

questions.question: How does the passage reason from Knowing to Life?
questions.answer: It argues that knowledge points to a living possessor, since knowledge belongs to one who is alive.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying purposive power belongs only to living beings?
questions.answer: It means power used with intention and aim is evidence of life.

questions.question: Why does the passage end by saying only a drop is being mentioned?
questions.answer: Because it says this truth has far more proofs than can be fully explained there.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the attribute of Speech?
questions.answer: It teaches that Speech makes Allah known by means of revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: How is the attribute of Power described as speaking without words?
questions.answer: Its created works function like visible messages that show who their Maker is.

questions.question: What can a reader infer from the image of the cosmos as a meaningful book?
questions.answer: The universe is full of signs that are meant to be understood, not seen as random.

questions.question: Which qualities of created things are linked to the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wisdom, order, balance, direction, beauty, and distinctness are linked to it.

questions.question: What makes Life stand out from the other attributes in this section?
questions.answer: The passage says many different proofs gather around it, making its evidence especially abundant.

questions.question: How do the signs of other attributes support the truth of Life?
questions.answer: Since power with purpose, knowledge, hearing, sight, will, and speech belong to the living, they all point back to Life.

questions.question: What does the constant renewal of the universe show?
questions.answer: It shows an ongoing living activity that keeps bringing forward fresh manifestations.

questions.question: Why might the passage call the universe a great mirror made of many smaller ones?
questions.answer: Because every part of creation reflects signs of Allah, and together they do so on a vast scale.

questions.question: Name four attributes besides Life that are said to reveal the Most Sacred Essence.
questions.answer: Knowledge, Seeing, Hearing, and Speech.

questions.question: What logical link does the passage make between Will and Life?
questions.answer: It says choosing and intending can only belong to one who is alive.

questions.question: What is the main conclusion of the final lines about Life?
questions.answer: Life is presented as a basic source and support for the other attributes.

questions.question: How does the mention of many proofs strengthen the passage’s overall message?
questions.answer: It shows that belief in Allah’s living reality is supported from many directions, not from one sign alone.

questions.question: In the passage, what reveals Allah through direct communication to people?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech reveals Him through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What reveals Allah through the created world?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power reveals Him through the works and effects seen in creation.

questions.question: Why are these works compared to outward words?
questions.answer: Because they carry meaning and point to the One who brought them into existence.

questions.question: What does the passage say the universe shows about its Creator when seen as a whole?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator is mighty and full of glory.

questions.question: How does the attribute of Knowledge appear in the world?
questions.answer: It appears in the careful arrangement, balance, adornment, and guidance of created things.

questions.question: What two kinds of proof are given for Life?
questions.answer: Proofs that belong directly to Life itself and proofs borrowed from all the other attributes.

questions.question: Who serves as reflecting witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: All living beings serve in that role.

questions.question: What effect does Life have on the condition of the cosmos?
questions.answer: It keeps the cosmos in motion and renewal so new forms continue to appear.

questions.question: What deeper point is made by saying the universe becomes a mirror?
questions.answer: The changing world continually reflects Divine signs in many forms.

questions.question: How are Seeing and Hearing treated in relation to Allah’s Essence?
questions.answer: They are among the attributes that make the Essence known.

questions.question: According to the passage, why does speech point to life?
questions.answer: Because speaking in a meaningful way belongs to one who has both life and knowledge.

questions.question: What rank is given to Life at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as a foundational attribute that supports the others and has extremely many evidences.

questions.question: What is the first comparison made about Speech in this passage?
questions.answer: It is compared with revelation and inspiration as a way Allah makes Himself known.

questions.question: What is the first comparison made about Power in this passage?
questions.answer: It is linked with crafted works in creation that point to Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage distinguish between Speech and Power?
questions.answer: Speech makes Allah known through communicated guidance, while Power makes Him known through created effects.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest a person should notice in creation to recognize Knowledge?
questions.answer: A person should notice the wisdom, order, balance, beauty, and precise distinction within created things.

questions.question: Why is Life not treated as just one attribute among many?
questions.answer: Because the passage presents it as supported by nearly all the other signs in the universe.

questions.question: How do living creatures help prove the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Their existence and qualities reflect many signs that point to the One who is ever-living.

questions.question: What is the connection between Life and the constant variety in the world?
questions.answer: Life is said to drive the ongoing renewal that brings out fresh forms and patterns.

questions.question: What does the image of countless small mirrors teach about creation?
questions.answer: Every part of creation can reflect something of Allah’s signs.

questions.question: Which attributes are grouped together after the discussion of Life?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking are grouped together.

questions.question: What common feature do Knowledge, Hearing, Seeing, Will, Power with purpose, and Speech share in the argument?
questions.answer: They all indicate the presence of life.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the claim that Life has proofs more numerous than the cosmos?
questions.answer: Its evidence is overwhelming and appears throughout all creation.

questions.question: How does the passage summarize the role of Life among the Divine attributes?
questions.answer: It presents Life as their basis, source, and support.

questions.question: Which attribute in the passage is linked to revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute is linked to skilled works and visible effects?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: What does the passage say those visible effects do?
questions.answer: They describe and point to a glorious and powerful Creator.

questions.question: How is the created world portrayed under the sign of Power?
questions.answer: It is portrayed as a meaningful cosmic book.

questions.question: What signs in creation point to the attribute of Knowledge?
questions.answer: Signs of wisdom, order, balance, management, beauty, and distinction.

questions.question: What makes the proof for Life broader than the proof for a single attribute?
questions.answer: Life is supported by its own evidence and also by the evidence for the other attributes.

questions.question: Why are animate beings especially important in this proof?
questions.answer: Because they display living signs directly and reflect many other Divine qualities.

questions.question: According to the passage, why does the cosmos keep changing?
questions.answer: So that ever-new manifestations and designs can appear.

questions.question: What does this constant change show about the universe?
questions.answer: It shows that the universe is actively displaying living and meaningful signs.

questions.question: Which four attributes are later mentioned together as also revealing the Essence?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: How does the passage argue that seeing and hearing imply life?
questions.answer: It treats them as qualities that belong only to one who is alive.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage make about Life?
questions.answer: It concludes that Life is a primary attribute with countless proofs and that it underlies the rest.
